Cilësi ndërtimi e lartë Fasada e veshur me gur natyral, dopjo tullë dhe izolim me lesh guri për një ambient të ngrohtë dhe efikas energjetik.
Pozicion i privilegjuar Mes gjelbërimit të kodrave të Petrelës, me ajër të pastër dhe qetësi absolute.
Hapësira të bollshme Organizim i mirëstrukturuar për rehati maksimale dhe një stil jetese ekskluziv.
Një oaz i vërtetë qetësie dhe elegance, perfekt për ata që kërkojnë një kombinim të luksit dhe natyrës!

title_en: ELITE VILLA FOR SALE IN PETRELE!
description_en: Luxury Villa in River Hill Tuscan Style Architecture, Between the Elegance and Tranquility of Nature In the heart of Petrella, in the exclusive River Hill residence, a unique villa with Tuscan architecture is offered for sale, designed to offer a refined and comfortable lifestyle. Key Features: Tuscan Architecture Mediterranean-inspired design, with authentic details and quality materials. High quality construction Facade covered with natural stone, double brick and stone wool insulation for a warm and energy efficient environment. Privileged position Among the greenery of the hills of Petrela, with fresh air and absolute tranquility. Ample spaces Well-structured organization for maximum comfort and an exclusive lifestyle. A real oasis of calm and elegance, perfect for those looking for a combination of luxury and nature! VILLA TYPE 2 Basement floor 84.2 m2 Ground floor 128.2 m2 First floor 84.2 m2 Land surface 560 m2 Organization: The villas have the day area on the ground floor, while the night area with the bedrooms is located on the upper floor. Each villa is equipped with a swimming pool in its own private courtyard. First Floor Day Floor Spacious living room with natural light Integrated kitchen and dining area Guest room for cozy reception Laundry room for additional functionality Distributing corridor that connects the spaces in an organized way Second Floor Night Floor This floor is designed for maximum privacy and comfort, with two spacious bedrooms and modern bathrooms. Yard: Ample green space with well maintained gardens and a relaxation area. Private outdoor pool and BBQ area. Two parking spaces for each villa Payment in installments: 50% in connection with the contract 30% after 18 months from the conclusion of the contract 20% after 23 months from the conclusion of the contract For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
